description: Catalog of soldier sprites used by the battle renderer and UI. Each entry describes the visual content of the artwork so designers and engineers can pick the right sprite without opening the file. Rarity and format fields are authoritative — see style-guide.json for the per-rarity art-treatment rules. SOURCE-OF-TRUTH RULE: this file is the single authority on which sprites exist. Enemy roster (src/game/army/enemy-cohort-data.ts) and ally pool (derived from src/game/army/cohort-data.ts) must reference only sprite ids declared here. Sprite ids listed in GOLD_RESERVED_SPRITE_IDS (src/game/army/cohort-data.ts) are fully-gold coin-style sprites reserved for narrative use and must NOT appear in normal enemy/ally rosters — currently spartan_royal_super_rare and companion_super_rare.

conventions.shape: Circle sprites are designed to be displayed inside a circular clip with ~4% margin. Card sprites (leader tier) use 5:7 portrait orientation with full-art bleed.
conventions.orientation: Facing-forward framing (character centered, head and shield/weapon visible).
conventions.resolution: Source rasters are ~800–1400 px per side; the renderer downsamples to 60 * DPR (or 120 * DPR in high-res mode) via SpriteManager.loadShield().
conventions.colorSpace: sRGB, 8-bit RGBA, anti-aliased edges against transparent background.

filenameFields.culture: lowercase snake_case (gallic, roman, spartan_royal, athens_hoplite, persian_immortal, companion, war_elephant, roman_equite)
filenameFields.rarity: common | uncommon | rare | super-rare | secret-rare | leader (hyphenated in filenames, mirrors style-guide.json rarity ids)
filenameFields.format: soldier (circle portrait, foot unit) | cavalry (circle portrait, mounted unit — rider + horse/camel/elephant inside the ring) | card (5:7 full-art, reserved for leaders)

conventions.spriteIdPattern: {culture}_{rarity} — same as filename but with underscores only (super_rare, secret_rare). This is the JS-friendly key used in SpriteManager.shields and BattleUnit.spriteId.

sprites.characterNote: Mature mid-forties, greying only at the temples and in a close-trimmed short beard, dignified and iron-calm with a patrician bearing — NOT elderly, NOT grey-bearded, NOT hunched. The triarii's signature is WEALTH (Servian top-census class), not age: gilded muscle-cuirass + chased helm + ornate greaves + silver-inlaid cingulum + signet-ring are what read first. See feedback_triarii_wealth.md.
sprites.narrativeMoment: The 'res ad triarios redit' moment — a single darker silhouette over the triarius's right shoulder shows a staggering wounded Principes falling back through the triarii gap with his helm knocked askew and his pilum slipping from his fingers. Drifting battlefield smoke and embers catch a rim-light above the hasta tip. The iron wall of last resort.
